item: Diagnostics manifest opens with scan_limits; a scan a limit stopped reads not finished, budget reached; files split at 200 KB (rows 209, 211)
summary: R757 amended to defer to R466: Thorough keeps no default total (THOROUGH_BUDGET_S = None); OO_DIAG_THOROUGH_BUDGET_S sets one for the install, budget_min for a run, the per-scan caps keep OO_ALL_DIAG_*_MEMBER_DEADLINE_S. The manifest's scan_limits header names the total, who set it, each cap and where each is changed; status_text says not finished/not started, budget reached or own cap reached, never pass/fail. Measured basis: 53.5 min on a 12 M-mention field corpus, 145 s and 246 s on a lab machine (gate item 44). Row 211: DIAG_PART_BYTES = 200,000 (the user's 2026-11-15 rule over R119's 4,000,000), parts named part-NN-of-MM, OO_DIAG_VOLUME_MAX_MB still overrides, keyword export keeps 4 MB. Release lines: A Diagnostics file now opens with the time limits its scans ran under and where to change each one; a scan a limit stopped reads not finished, budget reached. Diagnostics files are now split at 200 KB each, named part N of M.
